summary: This tutorial explains how to use the "Find and Replace" feature in LibreOffice Writer, along with the "Spell Check" feature. It starts by opening a resume document and using the "Find and Replace" function to replace instances of "ramesh" with "manish." Advanced options allow for searching backward, limiting the search to selected text, and using regular expressions. The tutorial also covers how to change the language settings for spell checking, specifically switching from English India to English USA to ensure proper dictionary matching. Finally, it demonstrates enabling auto-spell check and correcting a misspelled word like changing "husewifa" to "housewife."
